classdef.name: FlexLayoutAttributeOption
classdef.shortdesc: Options for applying flex layout attributes to flex object.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the FlexLayoutAttributeOption (a ObjectStyle).

property.name: flexWidthMode
property.shortdesc: The width behavior of the flex container. Can return: FlexWidthHeightMode enumerator or FlexEnum enumerator.

property.name: flexHeightMode
property.shortdesc: The height behavior of the flex container. Can return: FlexWidthHeightMode enumerator or FlexEnum enumerator.

property.name: flexDirection
property.shortdesc: The direction of the flex container

property.name: flexWrap
property.shortdesc: Whether flex items are forced onto one line or can wrap onto multiple lines

property.name: justifyContent
property.shortdesc: Defines how the browser distributes space between and around content items along the main-axis. Can return: FlexPosition enumerator or FlexSpacing enumerator.

property.name: alignItems
property.shortdesc: Defines the default behavior for how flex items are laid out along the cross axis. Can return: FlexPosition enumerator or FlexEnum enumerator.

property.name: flexPaddingTop
property.shortdesc: The top padding of the flex container

property.name: flexPaddingRight
property.shortdesc: The right padding of the flex container

property.name: flexPaddingBottom
property.shortdesc: The bottom padding of the flex container

property.name: flexPaddingLeft
property.shortdesc: The left padding of the flex container

property.name: flexGapRow
property.shortdesc: The row gap between flex items

property.name: alignContent
property.shortdesc: Aligns a flex container's lines within when there is extra space in the cross-axis. Can return: FlexPosition enumerator or FlexEnum enumerator.

property.name: flexGapColumn
property.shortdesc: The column gap between flex items

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the FlexLayoutAttributeOption.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
